message.content: {"note_claim": "The 20-49 age range refers to the youngest and oldest crew members in the air operation, not Delta Force operators.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "\"Our youngest crew member was 20 and our oldest crew member was 49,\" he said.", "reason": "The page directly quotes the Joint Chiefs chairman attributing the 20-49 age range to crew members, while separately identifying Delta Force as part of the extraction force, confirming the note's correction."}

parsed.note_claim: The 20-49 age range refers to the youngest and oldest crew members in the air operation, not Delta Force operators.
